entities.name: Query arginine deiminase
observations: The 402-residue sequence is an exact sequence match to reviewed Mycobacterium avium arginine deiminase A0QBT9.
The sequence contains the ADI Pfam domain PF02274.23 spanning residues 36–399.
The conserved catalytic cysteine is at position 392, annotated as forming an amidino-cysteine intermediate in reference arginine deiminases.

entities.name: Arginine deimination
observations: EC 3.5.3.6 / Rhea RHEA:19597: L-arginine + H2O → L-citrulline + NH4(+).
This is the first step of the arginine deiminase pathway, producing citrulline and ammonium from L-arginine.

entities.name: Arginine deiminase pathway
observations: The enzyme participates in L-arginine degradation and the pathway supplying carbamoyl phosphate from L-arginine.
Reference annotations place the enzyme in the cytoplasm.

entities.name: Apremilast
observations: The supplied stereochemical SMILES matches apremilast, PubChem CID 9912092.
